title: nan
authors: Jarraya I.; Gabr K.; Abdelkader M.; Alahmed F.; Bilal Kadri M.; Boulila W.
key_contribution: Presents a comparative study of TERCOM-EKF and ViSensorRF (random forest regression) methods for UAV localization in GNSS-denied environments, with quantitative evaluation in simulation.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Visual_LiDAR_Inertial_Fusion to ensure precise positioning.
